decisions.executionNote: Lift left arm into elbow-up approach; begin orienting for the farther left tube. Right arm stays at origin.
Advance above the farther left tube while aligning the open jaws to its diagonal axis.
Finish downward grasp orientation and approach the tube body, stopping above contact for visual correction.
Lower toward the tube while shifting along its axis toward the cap for a centered body grasp.
Fine-align the left jaws with the tube body and close; retention will be checked by lifting.
Lift and retreat the first tube while maintaining a closed grasp, checking visual retention before reorientation.
The first tube is visually retained. Move toward a left rack slot while smoothly rotating it upright.
Complete the upright rotation above the left side of the rack, keeping clearance for visual slot alignment.
Align the upright tube with a left-front rack opening and lower toward the entry; depth remains visually uncertain.
Lower the retained upright tube slowly into the left rack opening, keeping lateral alignment fixed.
Seat the first tube a little deeper, open the gripper, then begin clearing the rack to verify it remains upright.
The first tube remains upright after release. Withdraw the left gripper clear of the rack before approaching the next tube.
Move toward the remaining left tube and begin rotating the open gripper into its diagonal pickup orientation.
Complete the second tube pickup orientation while approaching above its body; preserve elbow-up continuity.
Descend around the second tube body, correcting the lateral offset seen in the wrist view.
Fine-align along the second tube body and close the left gripper for a lift test.
Lift the second tube clear of the table with the gripper closed, checking that it follows the hand.
The second tube follows the hand. Carry it toward the middle rack opening while rotating it upright.
Finish bringing the second tube upright over the middle slot, keeping it above the rack for alignment.
Lower the upright second tube toward the center opening while keeping the first inserted tube undisturbed.
Continue the second tube insertion with a small lateral correction toward the center of the opening.
Seat the second tube gently, release it, and begin withdrawing to check that it stays upright.
Two tubes remain upright after release. Clear the left arm from the rack and start the right arm's elbow-up approach to the final tube.
Bring the right gripper above the final tube while continuing the left arm's return toward origin.
Finish the right downward approach above the tube, and ease the left arm closer to its original pose.
Lower the right gripper and shift toward the tube's cap for a body grasp, while settling the left arm at origin.
Center the final tube between the right jaws and close around its body.
Lift the final tube away from the tabletop to check retention before carrying it to the rack.
The last tube is retained. Carry it inward in the right workspace and begin rotating it upright above the rack.
Continue carrying the final tube over the rightmost rack opening with gradual upright rotation.
Complete upright alignment of the last tube over the right rack slot before descending.
Lower the last upright tube toward the right opening with a small centering correction.
Insert the third tube vertically into the right slot, keeping its lateral position fixed.
Finish seating and release the final tube, then begin clearing the gripper to verify all three remain in the rack.
All three tubes remain upright after release. Withdraw the right gripper clear of the rack before returning to origin.
Return the right arm toward home on a raised, continuous elbow-up path; make a small left-origin correction.
